verdicts.reason: A and B look the same at pixel level. Both cram the four-line headline into the left of a tiny banner, where it is barely legible. The body copy is reduced to unreadable specks. The LIMITED EDITION pill sits jammed under the headline with almost no gap, and the 'Award Winning 2026' text and the CTA float in the top-right corner. The bottle, the SOLSTICE logo and the SUSET SALE ribbon are lost or made trivial, so this is a shrunk-down cluster rather than a real banner rearrangement.
